slice: W217 specialized Wide projection readers with W218 Tuple metadata and W219 physical names
status: VERIFIED within the finite declared scope
claim: Explicitly selected complete Wide projection children reuse existing Object, Array(JSON), recursive Tuple(JSON), Dynamic bulk and exact grouped Count readers through low-level and OfflineTable consumers. Canonical escaped Count/ordinary UInt64 names and bounded Default Tuple metadata compose existing owners; no leaf codec or writer wire profile is added.
source_state: Observed uncommitted W217/W218/W219 candidate against the baseline; exact source manifest and scoped file pins below identify executed bytes. The coherent local commit contains this evidence index; its own hash is not self-referenced.

admission.child_context: All selected parents require the named child. Child schemas, row counts, mark axes, checksums and physical rosters are authoritative. Parent identity remains in callbacks. Missing child never falls back to parent data.
admission.tuple_metadata: Schema-ordered direct structural/BinaryBulk Tuple info; exact arity, Default fields, bounded counts and optional Boolean exact_num_defaults. Array/non-Tuple metadata remains opaque even if value codecs recurse. Primitive metadata does not prove leaf type identity. Depth/node/element owner limits and sparse selected-record compatibility remain enforced.
admission.count_names: Canonical uppercase bytewise filename escaping of logical names, including raw percent. Physical hash/file identity uses escaped names. Count profile and UInt64 sibling must match child axes. Ordinary UInt64 escaping excludes JSON typed-path and flattened-Nested contexts; shared range reads use the same binding.
admission.writer: Existing ASCII name grammar and serialization profiles remain unchanged; no projection writer added.
admission.checksum_boundary: Selected checksum entries are admitted by shape/size; production checksum payload hashing is not implemented or claimed. Count hidden sibling payload values are not materialized by Count-only scans.

architecture.composition: One base codec plus wrapper-local composition rules; physical plans carry names, roles, domains, metadata/state, schedules and budgets. Consumer adapters propagate child context. One codec/class per wrapper product is neither implemented nor desired.
architecture.remaining_local_guards: Some rejected products are CrystalClick admission restrictions, not CH laws. Array(QBit) is rejected locally but present in pinned CH Array construction and stateless test 04817; its physical implementation is still open.
architecture.risk: CAUTION: public storage admission, serializer metadata and shared physical stream identity
architecture.rollback: Revert only the coherent local feature commit; preserve unrelated changes. No push or remote history mutation.
architecture.broad_facade_decomposition: Open. One extracted metadata owner does not close repository-wide one-class-per-file modularity.

source_reference.distinction: Pinned shallow comparison source is distinct from the stock executable's build and is not a perpetual latest-master claim.

source_lineage.native_manifest_roster: Exact sorted src/crystal_click.cr + src/crystal_click/**/*.cr + frozen Crystal oracle; pre/post bytes and current live roster/sizes/hashes audited for both modes.
